title: hunch_task finish and hunch_report return the full report inline and exceed host tool-result limits
observation: hunch_task(action: finish) and hunch_report(task_id) returned the entire hunch.task-report/1 document as structuredContent, including every delivered envelope's full context text and every record's lesson text. A task with 18 context deliveries produced a 101,623-character finish result and a 95,634-character report result; the Claude Code host refused both as exceeding the tool-result token limit and wrote them to a file, so the contribution card the agent must relay was not visible to it without a shell round-trip. RESOLVED 2026-09-12 by PR #176 (merged ef292a4, shipped in 1.32.1): both tools now return the bounded hunch.task-report-summary/1 (identities and verdicts, 48 KB budget, no envelope text) with the card; the full report stays in `hunch report <id> --json` and the HTML view.
